description: One page to read before building a 3D model, made for small models: what the thing is, the ready-made kind to start from (with its build command), the parts to name your nodes after, typical size, rules, the usual mistakes, the order of tools to call, and a short spec cheat sheet. `text` is a name or a short description in English or Dutch; typos and plurals work. Replaces calling godot_model_identify and godot_model_spec separately when you just want to start; call those instead when you need every detail (all variants and sizes, or the full spec). Returns plain text. Read-only.

text.description: what you want to make, e.g. 'a rowing boat', 'dragon', 'castle wall'

name: godot_model_brief
title: Briefing before you build a model
